description:
Fatima Fertilizer is proud to be the first company in Pakistan to partner with UNDP on adopting the SDGs Impact Framework!

This milestone reaffirms our commitment to sustainable development and highlights our dedication to transforming agriculture, empowering rural women, digital transformation, and community upliftment.

Fatima Fertilizer together with UNDP,  is setting a new benchmark for sustainable growth in Pakistan, fostering a lasting impact on our communities and environment.

#FatimaFertilizer #SarsabzPakistan #UNDP #SDGs #SustainablePakistan #GreenPakistan #SalamKissan



Directed by: Jamshed Raza (Jami) 
Fatima Fertilizer Team: Mariam Naeem Siddiqi, Muhammad Muzaffar Mazari and Fahad Mehmood 
Special Thanks: Wasim Khan 
Assistant Director: Saima
fulltitle: Leading Sustainable Change for Pakistan | Fatima Fertilizer in partnership with UNDP
